bagPolicy.summary: The Alamodome enforces a clear bag policy to enhance public safety, allowing only specific sizes and types of bags. Exceptions are made for diaper bags and medically necessary bags.
allowed: Small bags and/or clutches - 5.5”x 8.5” or smaller
prohibited: Any non-clear bag larger than 5.5” x 8.5”
bagPolicy.note: Exceptions are made for diaper bags and medically necessary bags, which will be screened prior to entry.

parking.note: The Alamodome offers several parking lots for event attendees. Pricing may vary depending on the event, and it's recommended to arrive early to secure a spot. Consider using public transportation or rideshare services to avoid parking congestion.

rideshare.note: Use Lot D at 500 Tower of Americas Way for rideshare pickup and drop-off. It is on the southbound I-37 access road between Montana Street and César E. Chávez Boulevard. Follow the pedestrian walkway to the North Plaza security checkpoint, ACP A.

concessions.note: The Alamodome offers a dining experience inspired by the authenticity of San Antonio's people and foods, with a focus on quality and sustainability. Legends Global provides food services, emphasizing fresh ingredients from local businesses and environmentally friendly practices.

accessibility.title: Accessibility & ADA Services
accessibility.body: Accessible parking is in Lot A: 127 spaces, first come, first served, with a valid placard or plate, at event parking rates. Lot A also has the accessible ramp and a free drop-off area that stays open even when the lots fill up. Wheelchair escorts are available from Guest Services at the main entrances.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted after you leave the venue.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Will Call
ticketPickup.body: Will call is at the northeast box office windows on the day of the event. On event days, the box office usually opens at least two hours before the show and takes cash and most cards. Online sales are through Ticketmaster only.

gates.title: Gates & Doors
gates.body: Doors open one (1) hour prior to the start time of an event. Wheelchair escorts are provided through Guest Services located at the main entrances for every event.
